place.en: The River Lord's shrine · The Zhang stands up

setup.zh: 漳水忽然停了——跟着一整条河从河床上立了起来。水墙正中浮上来一个人影，脚底下踩着两条青龙。岸上几千个人一齐跪下；你没跪。
setup.en: The Zhang suddenly stops — and then the whole river stands up from its bed. From the middle of the wall of water a figure rises, two blue dragons under its feet. Thousands on the bank kneel as one; you do not.

recap.zh: 漳水立起，河伯踩着两条青龙从水墙里升起来；两条龙试了那个不跪的人——他不避，张开两只手挡在了豆腐西施前头。上游柳荫里，老井看了他一眼。
recap.en: The Zhang stood up and the River Lord rose from the wall of water on two blue dragons; the dragons tested the one who would not kneel — he did not step aside, and stood with both hands spread in front of the Tofu Beauty. In the willow shade upstream, Old Well looked at him once.

zh: 二十五只船，二十五件嫁衣。
几千个人跪下。一个人没跪。

story.zh:
小满本来以为，事情就到这里了。

哪知漳水忽然停了。不是退，是停：河面上的浪一道一道，全悬在了半空，一滴也不落下来。岸上几千个人，一齐闭上了嘴。

话音未落，漳水竟站了起来。不是涨，是站——一整条河从河床上立起来，立成了一道墙。

小满数了数，二十五只船。二十五件嫁衣。

岸上几千个人，一齐跪了下去。三老跪着，巫祝瘫着，豆腐西施站在岸边，瞪大了眼睛。小满没跪。他两条腿早软了，可他没跪，只死死攥着胸口的木牌。

几千个人里，站着的只有三个。一个是豆腐西施，她是哑巴，跪下去也喊不出冤，便索性不跪；一个远远地站在上游那排老柳树底下，是个少年，一身白衣，腰里悬着一柄剑，年纪看着跟小满差不多；还有一个，便是沈小满。

那柳树底下，其实还有一个人。他也穿白，站在那个佩剑的少年身后半步，站在柳荫最深的地方，岸上的人跪着，瞧不见他；小满站着，瞧见了。瘦长的一条影子，背着手，一动也不动。那是老井。老井站在少年的身后，像一个跟班；这样看来，那个少年在太一宫里的身份，比老井还要高。银月只说了一句：「藏好，别叫老井多看你。」老井要是多看几眼，看见的便是木牌里头那一个了。

河伯脚下，左边那条龙动了。
story.en:
Xiaoman had thought that was the end of it.

Then the Zhang suddenly stopped. Not ebbed: stopped. Wave after wave on the river hung in mid-air, and not one drop fell. The thousands on the bank all shut their mouths at once.

Before the words had died away, the Zhang stood up. Not rose: stood. The whole river stood up out of its bed into a wall.

Xiaoman counted. Twenty-five boats. Twenty-five bride's dresses.

The thousands on the bank went down on their knees all together. The Three Elders knelt, the shaman lay sprawled, the Tofu Beauty stood at the water's edge with her eyes wide. Xiaoman didn't kneel. His legs had long since gone weak, but he didn't kneel; he only clutched the wooden tablet at his chest.

Of all those thousands, only three were standing. One was the Tofu Beauty: she was mute, and kneeling she still couldn't cry out her wrong, so she simply didn't kneel. One stood far off under the row of old willows upstream, a youth in white with a sword at his waist, about Xiaoman's age by the look of him. And the last was Shen Xiaoman.

Under those willows there was in fact one more person. He wore white too and stood half a step behind the youth with the sword, in the deepest part of the willow shade; the people on the bank were kneeling and couldn't see him, but Xiaoman, standing, could. A long, thin shadow, hands clasped behind his back, not moving at all. It was Old Well. Old Well stood behind the youth like an attendant; which meant the youth's standing in the Taiyi Palace was higher even than Old Well's. Yinyue said only one thing: "Keep hidden. Don't let Old Well look at you twice." If Old Well looked a few times more, what he would see was the one inside the wooden tablet.

Under the River Lord's feet, the dragon on the left moved.

exits.means: stands his ground and faces the two dragons' test without showing his Foundation

withdrawn.zh: 两条龙一扑一扫，都落了空，升回河伯脚下。它们还在等。
withdrawn.en: The dragons lunge and sweep and miss, and rise back to the River Lord's feet. They are still waiting.

story.zh:
小满喘着气，心里却已算明白了：它们不是来杀他的。真要杀，头一扑他便没了。这是在试。可试什么？试他跑得快不快，还是试他——

他没来得及想完。两条龙一齐动了。这一回它们不冲他，是从他两边绕过去，一左一右，直扑他身后的河岸。豆腐西施站在那里，站在一群跪着的人前头，嫁衣还穿在身上，一双眼睛睁得大大的，动也不动。

小满只要往旁边让一步，这一扑便与他不相干了。他的腿想让。他娘说过，打不过就跑，跑不丢人。可他这一回没让。他往后退了两步，退到豆腐西施跟前，转过身来，背对着她，两条胳膊一张，挡在了两条龙的正中间。

两只手掌张开着，掌心朝外。

他什么本事也没使。他只是站在那里，泥从头发上一滴一滴往下掉，两个腿肚子在抖，抖得岸上的人都瞧得见。

他听见自己的声音，抖得不成样子，却一个字一个字地说出来了：「……她是卖豆腐的。她没招谁。」

两条龙瞧着他，龙须在风里一飘一飘。然后左边那条把鼻子凑过来，在他脑门上轻轻碰了一下，凉的，像腊月里的井水；跟着便收回头去，右边那条也跟着退了。它们缓缓升回半空，回到河伯脚下，盘好了，一动也不动了。

银月低低地道：「……傻子。」隔了一会儿，又道：「藏得倒还凑合。」

上游柳树底下，老井从柳荫最深的地方往前走了一步。日头照在他脸上，那张脸白得看不出年纪。他的眼睛没有看龙，也没有看河伯，看的是小满，和小满衣襟底下透出来的那一线银光。他看了一眼，便退回了柳荫里去。
story.en:
Xiaoman was panting, but he had already worked it out: they hadn't come to kill him. If they'd wanted to kill him, the first dive would have finished him. This was a test. But a test of what? Of how fast he could run, or of whether he —

He didn't get to finish the thought. Both dragons moved at once. This time they didn't come at him; they swung round him, one on each side, and went straight for the bank behind him. The Tofu Beauty was standing there, in front of a crowd of kneeling people, still in her bride's dress, her eyes wide open, not moving at all.

Xiaoman had only to step aside and that dive would be none of his business. His legs wanted to step aside. His mother had said: if you can't win, run; there's no shame in running. But this time he didn't step aside. He took two steps back, back to stand in front of the Tofu Beauty, turned round with his back to her, flung both arms wide, and stood square between the two dragons.

Both hands open, palms out.

He used no skill at all. He just stood there, mud dripping from his hair drop by drop, both calves shaking, shaking so that the people on the bank could see it.

He heard his own voice, shaking all to pieces, but getting the words out one by one: "…She sells tofu. She never hurt anyone."

The two dragons looked at him, their whiskers drifting in the wind. Then the one on the left brought its nose close and touched him lightly on the forehead, cold, like well water in the twelfth month; then it drew its head back, and the one on the right drew back too. They rose slowly back into the air, back to the River Lord's feet, coiled themselves up, and were still.

Yinyue said, low, "…Idiot." After a moment she added, "Hid yourself well enough, though."

Upstream under the willows, Old Well took one step forward out of the deepest shade. The sun fell on his face, a face so white you couldn't tell its age. His eyes weren't on the dragons, nor on the River Lord; they were on Xiaoman, and on the thread of silver light showing from under the front of Xiaoman's robe. He looked once, and stepped back into the willow shade.

exits.means: kneels like everyone else, gives in

text.zh: 你膝盖一软，又站直了。身后，豆腐西施没有跪。
text.en: Your knees give — and you straighten again. Behind you, the Tofu Beauty has not knelt.
